# Test music

Everything in `music/` is generated by `scripts/gen-testdata.sh` with ffmpeg: sine tones
(left channel at the listed frequency, right channel at 1.5 times it, amplitude about −24 dBFS)
with plain tags. No recordings, nothing copyrighted; the files are dedicated to the public
domain (CC0-1.0).

| Artist | Album | Files |
|---|---|---|
| Infrasonic Test Ensemble | Sine Studies (2024) | 3 × FLAC, 4 s, 220/440/880 Hz |
| The Codec Quartet | Formats Live (2025) | MP3, Vorbis, Opus, AAC (m4a), 5 s each, 330–390 Hz |
| Black Noise Collective | Black Album (2023) | 2 × MP3, 3 s |

The end-to-end tests (`crates/e2e`, `crates/tui/tests/headless.rs`) mount this directory into
Navidrome and gonic and rely on exactly these nine songs.

`gapless/` holds one continuous 6 s signal (440/660 Hz) cut into three parts of exactly
88200 frames, encoded separately as FLAC, MP3, Vorbis, Opus and AAC. All parts carry ReplayGain
tags (track −3 dB, album −4.5 dB). `crates/engine/tests/gapless.rs` checks that the parts play
back to back without gaps, also when resampled, and that ReplayGain is applied.
